messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Anmol Behl
anmol behl... solid name. where you working these days?
I am working as a Senior Software Engineer at Accenture
accenture... the consulting giant where everyone's "serving notice period" apparently. found you on linkedin - anmol b. serving notice period. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/behlanmol
Yes

senior software engineer at accenture serving notice period... lmao the linkedin headline that screams "get me out of here". smart move though - accenture's great for learning the ropes but terrible for your soul after a while. what made you finally pull the trigger on leaving?

I have been working there for quite long even though the work is good but I have my liabilities and family responsibilities. Plus I need to enhance my expertise in my domain. Therefore leaving Accenture

makes sense. family responsibilities hit different when you're stuck at a place that's comfortable but not paying what you're worth. accenture's that classic trap - good enough to stay, not good enough to thrive. how long you been working total?
4+ years at accenture straight out of college... that's basically your entire career there. no wonder you're itching to see what else is out there. what kind of role you looking for next?

senior sde at product companies with good pay... smart move. accenture to product is where the real money lives. with that .net + azure stack, you're basically built for fintech and enterprise saas. bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
I am open to noida gurugram and remote
4.2 years + senior sde + product companies + noida/gurugram/remote... sound right?
Sde or senior software engineer
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Sde or senior software engineer
  Does 4.2 years offer senior sde i think its just sde and sde 2

you're absolutely right. 4.2 years is classic sde-2 territory, not senior. senior usually kicks in around 5-6+ years.

so sde/sde-2 + product companies + good pay + noida/gurugram/remote... that's the real target. sound right?
Yes
perfect. you're locked in. i'll slide roles when they're good... btw what's making you want to leave accenture anyway? just growth or something else?
Growth and pay. Accenture has not been generous in paying good due to which i am lacking in my family responsibilities. Also I need to get more diversified and experienced in my current skills.

growth and pay... classic accenture story. they'll keep you comfortable but never pay what you're actually worth. family responsibilities don't care about "comfortable" though, they need real numbers.

what's the number that would actually change things for you?

Current ctc - 8 LPA CTC
I am currently serving notice period.
Lwd- 12 jan 2026
Current offer- 17.6 lpa ctc
Expected- 20-22 lpa ctc (negotiable)

8 → 17.6 → targeting 20-22... that's the kind of jump that actually changes things. accenture was paying you peanuts for that .net + azure stack. product companies will pay double-triple for that exact skillset.

17.6 is already solid for 4.2 years in noida/gurugram. 20-22 is definitely doable at the right places. what's the current offer from?
Bold Technology System Private Limited Noida

bold technology... not familiar with them but 17.6 for 4.2 years in noida is decent. you're right to keep looking though - 20-22 is definitely achievable with your stack.

what's the tech stack at bold? still .net/azure or something different?
.NET and Azure

perfect. staying in your lane but getting paid way more for it. that's exactly how you should be playing this.

so you're serving notice, have a 17.6 backup, and hunting for 20-22 in noida/gurugram/remote with .net/azure... you're in a good spot honestly. most people are desperate when they're serving notice.

what's your actual last working day? you said 12 jan 2026 but that's next year... typo?
Yes its is jan 12 2026

jan 12 2026... so you've got a full year of notice period? that's wild. accenture really locking people in.

good news is you can be picky. bad news is companies might be weird about a year-long notice. but with your backup offer, you've got leverage.

you're all set. i'll be sliding roles that actually fit... curious though, what would your dream role actually look like day to day?
Its not year long notice today is december 8 2025 its about a month left

ohhh wait you're right. december 8 2025 → jan 12 2026 is like a month, not a year. my brain short-circuited there.

so you're basically done with accenture in a month, have a 17.6 backup, and hunting for 20-22... that's actually perfect timing. companies love that you're available soon.

you're in the sweet spot. i'll be sliding roles.

Work life balance
Nice pay
Good work and growth opportunities 
Critical thinking and logic building opportunities

work-life balance + good pay + growth + actual challenging work... the holy grail. most companies give you 2 of those 4 at best.

you want somewhere that actually respects your time AND pays you for your skills. that's the real search.

i'll keep an eye out for places that don't just throw .net/azure work at you but actually build something interesting with it.

you're locked in.
Thank You
anytime. i'll be in your chats when something good pops up.
